newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end mostly lower, spot rise.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end mostly lower, spot rise.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed mostly lower on Thursday, as technical selling from local investors depressed the market, traders said.

Prices were 40 to 210 yen lower, with the benchmark January 1998 contract down 40 yen at 15,560 yen per tonne. The exception was the spot March 1997, which gained 40 yen to close at 17,030. The day"s volume was 49,688 lots.
The spot March contract expires on Friday.
Individual investors, who built long positions earlier this year, rushed to liquidate them particularly in nearby months, traders said.
The spot March contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $2.73-1/4 per bushel at 0740 GMT,
The spot March of the CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $7.63-1/2 at 0740 GMT, against $7.64-1/4 at Wednesday"s close.
